## Problem

Describe the bounded problem this PR solves.

## Change

Summarize the implementation/documentation changes.

## Governance impact

Check all that apply and explain any checked item below.

- [ ] Authority or trust boundary
- [ ] Policy interpretation
- [ ] Evidence/provenance semantics
- [ ] Persistent state or recovery
- [ ] External mutation/action
- [ ] Provider adapter behavior
- [ ] Constitution or protected governance
- [ ] No governance-boundary impact

## Validation

List tests, lint/static checks, and any independent review performed.

## Security / compatibility

Describe security implications, migrations, persistence-format changes, and backwards compatibility. Write `None` when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is bounded and unrelated refactors are excluded.
- [ ] Executable behavior has tests or the PR explains why tests are not applicable.
- [ ] Documentation/contracts are updated when behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, keys, private state, or private repository data are included.
- [ ] Fail-closed and provider-neutral invariants are preserved.
- [ ] An ADR is included when an architectural authority/trust boundary changes.
